newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu demands Arafat crack down after bombing.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu demands Arafat crack down after bombing.

text.p: Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu demanded Palestinian President Yasser Arafat crack down on militants after 13 people were killed in a double suicide bombing in Jerusalem on Wednesday.

"We expect the Palestinian Authority and its leader to begin to fight terror as they are committed to, as they haven't done until today, that they will take all the steps required against these terrorists and their operators who roam free," he told a news conference after a visit to wounded in hospital.
"They must be jailed, their weapons and their explosives collected," Netanyahu said.
"We aren't ready to accept that murderous acts will be part of our daily lives every few weeks and months and we will await suitable steps," he said.
Israeli police said 13 people, including the two suicide bombers, died in the attack on the Jewish street market in Jerusalem.
